nginx.reason: Astilba follows nginx's stable releases, whose minor version is even. Stable carries mainline's security fixes, so an odd mainline release is not an update.

postgres.reason: Managed PostgreSQL data moves to a later release in place only within one Alpine line, whose ICU (76.1 on 3.23) sorts indexes the same. Alpine 3.24 carries ICU 78.1, so moving lines needs its own recipe (docs/supported-upgrades.md#postgresql-releases).

ghcr.io/railwayapp/railpack-builder.reason: Railpack 0.43.0 builds on the builder image named after the mise it pins (RailpackMiseVersion in services/platform/internal/pipeline/railpack.go), and the agent refuses any other. Move this track with the Railpack release.

ghcr.io/railwayapp/railpack-runtime.reason: Railpack 0.43.0 builds on the runtime image named after the mise it pins (RailpackMiseVersion in services/platform/internal/pipeline/railpack.go), and the agent refuses any other. Move this track with the Railpack release.

jdx/mise.reason: The build fixture installs the mise that Railpack 0.43.0 pins (RailpackMiseVersion in services/platform/internal/pipeline/railpack.go), where Railpack looks for it. Move this track with the Railpack release.

The legacy singleton fixture (services/platform/internal/deployment/testdata/legacy-singleton.json) is a plan the preceding compiler made with it, whose hash and Compose output must stay the same, so the fixture keeps naming it.
